If adverse impact on some minority group has been observed, which of the following types
of tests probably has the best chance of withstanding legal challenge

A correct statement about the early babbling of infants from different language
communities is chat it

options.A: is different for each language community from the onset of babbling
options.B: depends upon the semantic structure of the language
options.C: depends upon the phonetic structure of the language
options.D: is the same for each language community until the first sentences are formed
